fills.researcher_notes: GENUINE, WELL-EVIDENCED CONFLICT -- flagging, not resolving. GEM's recorded StartYear1=1965 traces (per the gem.wiki citation list, read for leads only) to a kazan-tr.gazprom.ru 'podrobno' page that could not be reached this session (ConnectTimeout) or verified via Wayback (session-wide 503 outage on web.archive.org), so it could not be independently re-confirmed. Meanwhile energybase.ru -- independently verified live this session -- gives 1976 for a catalog object that matches this pipeline exactly on two other independent specs (Length 249km, Diameter 530mm), which gives real confidence energybase.ru is describing the same physical pipeline, not a different one. Separately, tatarica.org's Tatarstan gasification encyclopedia article notes that in 1962 a partial section of 'газопровод Миннибаево–Ижевск' was built out to the town of Zainsk -- consistent with a staged, multi-year construction process (partial section 1962, further sections possibly 1965, final full commissioning per energybase possibly 1976). None of this cleanly resolves which single year GEM should record. Recommend a human follow-up once kazan-tr.gazprom.ru / Wayback access is restored, to determine whether 1965 refers to a partial-completion milestone (matching the Zainsk-section pattern) while 1976 is full commissioning, or whether one of the two figures is simply wrong. No value change made; recorded value (1965) is kept as UNRESOLVED with this conflict documented in the paired validity record.
